a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly leaves us both with empty units when a storm hits. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random and we both likely fail, so I'd rather say this openly than surprise you. If you have a better plan that doesn't depend on surviving several storm rolls, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. With storms this likely, I don't think waiting to reach 8 could have saved either of us. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so the reserve can grow for you.
